basics.name: Dr Josh Veitch-Michaelis
basics.label: Applied Machine Learning Researcher
basics.summary: Applied machine learning researcher specialising in remote sensing, with over a decade of software development experience. I have worked in academia and industry, from space science to ecology and I'm passionate about using technology for social good and planetary stewardship. I have wintered in Antarctica for two world-class telescopes (IceCube and SPT).

work.name: University of Chicago
work.summary: Operated SPT, on-call 24/7. Hardware and cluster management, supported Event Horizon Telescope operations and contributed to SPT's codebase.

work.name: Frontier Development Lab
work.summary: Co-supervised a research group to now-cast space weather events like flares and CMEs, working with ESA's VIGIL team (on-ground and on-satellite ML deployment).

work.name: ETH Zürich / Restor
work.position: Postdoc in AI for Remote Sensing (Systems Group)
work.summary: Informed Restor's AI strategy applied to remotely sensed data from partner orgs. Developed Restor's open-source tree crown delineation pipeline, including dataset curation/annotation, ML model training and benchmarking on user data.

work.name: Wisconsin-Madison University
work.summary: Operated the IceCube Neutrino Observatory at the South Pole, providing 24/7 critical hardware and software support. Maintained an on-prem cluster of 100+ machines.

work.name: Liverpool John Moores University
work.position: Postdoctoral Research Assistant in Drone Image Analyses (Astro-Ecology)
work.summary: Led instrument design for a real-time, drone-mounted endangered species detection system using thermal/visible imaging and deep learning. Collaborations with Save The Elephants (Kenya), WWF, ZSL (London), Durrell (Madagascar) and Knowsley Safari.

work.name: Frontier Development Lab, Europe
work.summary: Development of a satellite-based flood segmentation model, supported by UNICEF and ESA. Presented at NeurIPS HADR workshop, 2 follow-up papers in Sci. Rep. Launched on a D-Orbit satellite in June 2021 and was flight-tested in space.

work.name: I3D Robotics Ltd. & IS Instruments Ltd
work.summary: Designed bespoke 3D imaging and analysis systems, including embedded ML. Clients included robotics, heavy industry (steel), agriculture and nuclear.

volunteer.summary: IWA is a non-profit organisation that runs the International Astronomical Youth Camp (iayc.org). Supervised over 50 participants, held various board positions and continue to support the camp.
Linux server administration, deployment on GCP.
